title: PIRIN EXTREME 38K - race day
terrain: 38.1km, 3440m D+ (GPX). Km 0-13: climb 923->2908m (Vihren). Km 13-28: traverse above 2000m, 9.7km above 2500m. Km 28-38: one 1250m descent to Bansko

steps.target: Z2, opening 1900m climb - hike, strictly conversational
Z2-Z3, high traverse - effort not pace, air is thin
Z2, final 1250m descent - controlled, short stride

coachNotes: Estimated 7h45 moving from your Erve pace reference + altitude penalty. The race is decided by two disciplines: (1) the opening climb at conversational effort no matter who passes you - 1900m continuous from the gun; (2) the final 1250m descent on 7h legs is the single ITB test of the day: poles, short stride, brake with cadence not quads. Half the course is above 2000m - expect pace to mean nothing, run on effort and HR. Fuel 70-90g carbs/h from minute one. Registration + mandatory medical check FRIDAY 13:00-20:00 in Bansko.
